title: Apple Juice Pie (Apple-less Apple Pie)
description: Try this Apple Juice Pie; only apple juice, no apples. Tastes just like an Apple Pie without the apples.

ingredients.item: Butter, shredded or cut into square pats

steps: Add the juice of half a lemon.
Mix together one cup of sugar and a quarter cup of all-purpose flour. Mix it up.
Evenly sprinkle the sugar-flour mixture over your pie. Do not stir.
Add some butter on top, shredded or cut into pats.
Reduce the heat to 375°F and bake for another 30 minutes.
Let it cool completely before refrigerating.
Refrigerate for 12 hours to let it set.
